strings.Juega contra Coco o con amigos en mesas: Play against Coco or with friends at tables for 2, 4 or 6.
strings.Tres cartas por mano. Jugá mano a mano o: Three cards per hand. Play head-to-head or in teams and decide when to call envido or truco.
strings.No puntúa para la clasificación general: Does not count towards the overall ranking
strings.Juega en este dispositivo o abre una sal: Play on this device or open a private room with a nickname.
strings.Elige cuántas personas van a jugar, crea: Choose how many people will play, create a room and share the invitation. The first hand is dealt when the last seat is filled.
strings.En un mismo dispositivo, cada jugador de: On a shared device, each player reveals their cards when they receive it and hides them at the end of their turn.
strings.Tienes el 6 y el 7 de oros y un rey de c: You hold the 6 and 7 of coins and the king of cups. What is your envido score?
strings.Tienes 33 de envido. El 6 y el 7 de oros: Your envido is 33. The 6 and 7 of coins add up to 13. Add 20 because they share a suit.
strings.¿Cómo invito a mis amigos?: How do I invite my friends?
strings.¿Puntúa para la clasificación general?: Does this game count towards the overall ranking?
strings.¿Qué variante de truco se juega?: Which variant of Truco are we playing?
strings.Truco argentino sin flor, a 15 o 30 punt: Argentine Truco without flor, played to 15 or 30 points. At a table of six, you always play in two teams of three.
strings.Se reparten tres cartas por persona. Los: Everyone gets three cards. Teammates sit in alternating seats. Each player plays one card per trick. The strongest card wins. Win two tricks to take the hand. If a trick is tied, the first trick won outright takes priority. If all three tie, the starting player’s team wins.
strings.De mayor a menor: 1 de espadas, 1 de bas: Strongest to weakest: 1 of swords, 1 of clubs, 7 of swords, 7 of coins, threes, twos, remaining ones, twelves, elevens, tens, remaining sevens, sixes, fives, fours.
strings.El truco sube el valor de la mano de 1 a: A hand is worth 1 point. An accepted truco raises it to 2, retruco to 3 and vale cuatro to 4. For envido, add your two best cards of the same suit plus 20. Face cards count as zero. With three different suits, count your highest card alone. Ties go to whoever plays earlier in the order, starting with the opening player. Falta envido is worth what the leading team needs to reach 15 if both sides are below 15, otherwise the match target. There is no flor. At a table of six, everyone plays every hand, without pica-pica duels.
